name: smwpatches-time-up-sfx-patch
title: Time Up + SFX Patch
description:
With this patch, you can have a SFX to play when the TIME UP screen appears, pretty much like the GAME OVER one does.
You can easily define what SFX will play in the .asm file.
Thanks to DiscoMan for fixing the jumps.

Also, this is my first patch, enjoy!
